'''Troll generals''' are one of the monsters fought during the combat portion of [[Troll Invasion]]. They appear first in wave 8 of the normal version and wave 3 of the hard version. They are generally a tougher version of the [[Mountain troll (Troll Invasion)|mountain troll]] seen in the invasion. They use high hitting melee attacks that are rather accurate, so it is advised to pray [[Protect from Melee]] or [[Deflect Melee]] against them.
